category: Restaurante de peixe frito e frutos do mar
active_evidence: Official HTTPS Curitiba page loaded successfully on 2026-07-18 in desktop and mobile browser captures; page publishes current menu, address, opening hours, WhatsApp, named chef, and a 2026 footer/copyright.
problems: The opening title and primary experience are generic rather than immediately clarifying the Curitiba proposition, signature dish, and visit action.
The page mixes long history copy, repeated promotional banners, menu blocks, and unit-selection content into a dense scroll with weak prioritization.
Menu and contact conversion are separated from the strongest food imagery; the visitor must scan before finding a clear visit/order path.
The official page publishes useful operational facts but does not present them as a concise, mobile-first decision path.
The page has a large amount of repeated or promotional content below the fold, diluting the strongest verified equity: the Peixe ao Forno story and family history.
rebuild_angle: Turn the verified family fish-specialist story and Peixe ao Forno into a focused Curitiba dining journey: signature dish first, menu and hours second, family provenance and unit context third, with a direct visit/contact action.
roi_mechanism: Reduce menu-and-location friction for diners making a same-day restaurant decision and make the verified signature dish, address, hours, and WhatsApp easier to act on.

observed_issue_urls_date.note: Current page captured at 1440x900 and 390x844; dense content hierarchy and weak first-action prioritization observed.

colors: #1C6B4A — sampled as the dominant green family in the official wordmark/visual system; retain as a restrained brand anchor.
#F4E8D1 — warm food-oriented neutral sampled from official banner and dish imagery; use as background evolution.

brand_source.typography: The current public site uses a conventional sans-serif WordPress presentation; use a sturdy humanist sans for navigation/body with a compact display face for dish names, preserving legibility while giving the food story more editorial character.
strongest_public_language: queremos que você se sinta não apenas como um cliente, mas como um convidado em nossa casa.
locations: Rua Brg. Franco, 3359 - Rebouças, Curitiba - PR
contacts: WhatsApp link published on official Curitiba page
equity_to_preserve: Peixe ao Forno as the documented carro-chefe
family-origin story beginning in Toledo-PR in 1998

concept_thesis: This concept can only belong to Restaurante Pantanal Curitiba because it turns the family Peixe ao Forno story into a warm, direct invitation to the Rebouças table.
concept_rules: Lead with the verified Peixe ao Forno image and a single visit/menu action.
Use a flowing river-like divider to connect Toledo origin to Curitiba table without inventing history.
Pair a sturdy sans with a compact editorial dish label system, never decorative script.
Crop official dish photography edge-to-edge on mobile with the plate focal point preserved.
Evolve the verified green system into warm cream surfaces, reserving red/orange for food-action cues.
Keep address, hours, menu, and WhatsApp within one persistent decision path.
factual_claim_sources: Official Curitiba home and cardápio pages listed in evidence_links; all dish names, history, address, and operating information must be copied only from those sources.
